```{r}
#| output: false
library(jsonlite)

load_election <- function(dir) {
  tryCatch(
    list(
      coalitions    = fromJSON(file.path(dir, "coalition_probabilities.json"), simplifyVector = FALSE),
      party_data    = fromJSON(file.path(dir, "party_shares.json"),            simplifyVector = FALSE),
      hurdle_data   = fromJSON(file.path(dir, "hurdle_probabilities.json"),    simplifyVector = FALSE),
      pollster_data = fromJSON(file.path(dir, "per_pollster.json"),            simplifyVector = FALSE),
      density_data  = fromJSON(file.path(dir, "coalition_densities.json"),     simplifyVector = FALSE)
    ),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
}

ojs_define(
  all_data = list(
    ST = load_election("data/st"),
    MV = load_election("data/mv"),
    BE = load_election("data/be"),
    BTW = load_election("data/btw")
  ),
  election_meta = list(
    ST = list(title = "Sachsen-Anhalt Landtagswahl 2026",         seats = 83L,  majority = 42L),
    MV = list(title = "Mecklenburg-Vorpommern Landtagswahl 2026", seats = 71L,  majority = 36L),
    BE = list(title = "Abgeordnetenhauswahl Berlin 2026",          seats = 130L, majority = 66L),
    BTW = list(title = "Bundestagswahl 2029", seats = 630L, majority = 316L)
  ),
  party_colors = list(
    cdu = "#1c1c1b", spd = "#e3000f", afd = "#82caff",
    greens = "#46962b", fdp = "#ffed00", fw = "#005fa3",
    left = "#be3075", bsw = "#6d1f99", others = "#aaaaaa"
  ),
  party_names = list(
    cdu = "Union", spd = "SPD", afd = "AfD",
    greens = "Grüne", fdp = "FDP", fw = "Freie Wähler",
    left = "Linke", bsw = "BSW", others = "Sonstige"
  )
)
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
d3 = require("d3@7")
party_order = ["left", "spd", "bsw", "greens", "fdp", "fw", "cdu", "afd"]

label_to_party = Object.fromEntries(
  Object.entries(party_names).map(([party, label]) => [label, party])
)

party_to_label = Object.fromEntries(
  Object.entries(label_to_party).map(([label, party]) => [party, label])
)

coalitionParties = label =>
  label.split("-").map(label => label_to_party[label])

normCoalition = label =>
  coalitionParties(label).slice().sort().join("|")

labelFromParties = parties =>
  parties.map(party => party_to_label[party] || party).join("-")

meanBy = (data, keyFn, valueFn) =>
  Array.from(
    d3.rollup(data, v => d3.mean(v, valueFn), keyFn),
    ([key, value]) => ({ key, value })
  )

cleanShares = shares => {
  return meanBy(
    shares.filter(d => d.party !== "others"),
    d => d.party,
    d => d.percent
  )
    .map(d => ({
      party: d.key,
      percent: d.value,
      label: party_names[d.key] || d.key
    }))
    .sort((a, b) => party_order.indexOf(a.party) - party_order.indexOf(b.party))
}

cleanHurdles = hurdles => {
  return meanBy(
    hurdles.filter(d => d.party !== "others" && d.prob_above_hurdle < 0.5),
    d => d.party,
    d => d.prob_above_hurdle
  )
    .map(d => ({
      party: d.key,
      prob_above_hurdle: d.value,
      label: party_names[d.key] || d.key
    }))
    .sort((a, b) => b.prob_above_hurdle - a.prob_above_hurdle)
}

cleanCoalitions = (coalitions, shares) => {
  const partyVotes = Object.fromEntries(
    cleanShares(shares).map(d => [d.party, d.percent])
  )

  const labelByVotes = parties => {
    const ordered = parties
      .slice()
      .sort((a, b) => (partyVotes[b] ?? -Infinity) - (partyVotes[a] ?? -Infinity))

    return labelFromParties(ordered)
  }

  const byLabel = Array.from(
    d3.rollup(
      coalitions,
      v => d3.mean(v, d => d.probability),
      d => d.label
    ),
    ([label, probability]) => ({
      label,
      probability,
      parties: coalitionParties(label),
      coalition_key: normCoalition(label)
    })
  )

  return Array.from(
    d3.group(
      byLabel.filter(d =>
        !d.parties.includes("bsw") &&
        !(d.parties.includes("afd") && d.parties.length > 1)
      ),
      d => d.coalition_key
    ),
    ([coalition_key, rows]) => {
      rows.sort((a, b) =>
        d3.descending(a.probability, b.probability) ||
        d3.ascending(a.label, b.label)
      )

      const probability = d3.sum(rows, d => d.probability)
      const label = d3.max(rows, d => d.probability) > 0
        ? rows[0].label
        : labelByVotes(rows[0].parties)

      const first_party = coalitionParties(label)[0]

      return {
        coalition_key,
        label,
        first_party,
        probability
      }
    }
  ).sort((a, b) => a.probability - b.probability)
}

densityRows = densityData => {
  const densities = densityData?.densities ?? []
  if (Array.isArray(densities)) return densities

  const columns = Object.keys(densities)
  if (columns.length === 0) return []

  const n = densities[columns[0]]?.length ?? 0
  return d3.range(n).map(i =>
    Object.fromEntries(columns.map(column => [column, densities[column][i]]))
  )
}

densityValue = function normalizeDensityValue(value) {
  if (Array.isArray(value)) return normalizeDensityValue(value[0])
  if (value && typeof value === "object" && 0 in value) return normalizeDensityValue(value[0])
  if (value && typeof value === "object" && "value" in value) return normalizeDensityValue(value.value)
  if (value && typeof value === "object" && Object.keys(value).length === 1) {
    return normalizeDensityValue(value[Object.keys(value)[0]])
  }
  return +value
}

densitySource = (data, selectedInstitute) => {
  const pollster = selectedInstitute === "Pooled" ? "pooled" : selectedInstitute
  const densities = densityRows(data?.density_data)
  const latestDate = d3.max(
    densities.filter(d => d.pollster === pollster),
    d => new Date(d.date)
  )

  return densities.filter(d =>
    d.pollster === pollster &&
    +new Date(d.date) === +latestDate
  )
}

coalitionDensityOptions = (data, selectedInstitute) => {
  const densities = densitySource(data, selectedInstitute)
  return new Map(
    Array.from(
      d3.rollup(densities, rows => rows[0].label, d => d.coalition),
      ([coalition, label]) => [label, coalition]
    ).sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a[0], b[0]))
  )
}

normalizeDensityCurve = rows => {
  const dat = rows
    .map(d => ({
      ...d,
      seat_share: densityValue(d.seat_share),
      density: Math.max(0, densityValue(d.density))
    }))
    .filter(d => Number.isFinite(d.seat_share) && Number.isFinite(d.density))
    .sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a.seat_share, b.seat_share))

  return dat
}

plotCoalitionDensity = (rows, height = 260) => {
  const dat = normalizeDensityCurve(rows)
  const label = rows[0]?.label ?? ""

  if (dat.length < 2 || !Number.isFinite(d3.max(dat, d => d.density))) {
    return html`<div style="font-weight:700">${label}</div>`
  }

  const probMajority = densityValue(rows[0]?.prob_majority)
  const ciLower = densityValue(rows[0]?.ci_lower)
  const ciUpper = densityValue(rows[0]?.ci_upper)
  const ciLowerSeats = densityValue(rows[0]?.ci_lower_seats)
  const ciUpperSeats = densityValue(rows[0]?.ci_upper_seats)
  const maxDensity = d3.max(dat, d => d.density)
  const threshold = 0.5
  const leadingParty = label.split("-")[0] ?? label
  const hasInterval = Number.isFinite(ciLower) && Number.isFinite(ciUpper)
  const hasSeatInterval = Number.isFinite(ciLowerSeats) && Number.isFinite(ciUpperSeats)
  const probabilityLabel = probMajority < 0.001
    ? "<0,1%"
    : `${(probMajority * 100).toFixed(1).replace(".", ",")}%`
  const intervalLabel = hasSeatInterval
    ? `${ciLowerSeats.toFixed(0)} - ${ciUpperSeats.toFixed(0)}`
    : ""

  const plot = Plot.plot({
    height,
    width: Math.max(900, window.innerWidth - 430),
    marginTop: 56,
    marginRight: 42,
    marginBottom: 42,
    marginLeft: 42,
    x: {
      label: null,
      domain: [0, 1],
      ticks: [0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1],
      tickFormat: d => `${(d * 100).toFixed(0)}%`,
      axis: "top"
    },
    y: {
      label: null,
      domain: [-0.12 * maxDensity, maxDensity],
      axis: null
    },
    marks: [
      Plot.ruleX([0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1], {
        stroke: "#bdbdbd",
        strokeDasharray: "5 6",
        strokeWidth: 1.4
      }),
      Plot.areaY(dat.filter(d => d.seat_share <= threshold), {
        x: "seat_share",
        y1: 0,
        y2: "density",
        fill: "#d1d0ce",
        fillOpacity: 0.95
      }),
      Plot.areaY(dat.filter(d => d.seat_share >= threshold), {
        x: "seat_share",
        y1: 0,
        y2: "density",
        fill: "#0072b6",
        fillOpacity: 0.95
      }),
      Plot.lineY(dat, {
        x: "seat_share",
        y: "density",
        stroke: "#777",
        strokeWidth: 1
      }),
      Plot.ruleY([0], {
        stroke: "#bdbdbd",
        strokeWidth: 5
      }),
      ...(hasInterval ? [
        Plot.ruleY([{ y: -0.085 * maxDensity, x1: ciLower, x2: ciUpper }], {
          y: "y",
          x1: "x1",
          x2: "x2",
          stroke: "#f39c12",
          strokeWidth: 5
        })
      ] : [])
    ]
  })

  return html`
    <div>
      <div style="text-align:center;font-size:1.08rem;line-height:1.2;margin:10px 0 22px 0;position:relative;z-index:1">
        Anteil der Sitze im Parlament
      </div>
      ${plot}
      <div style="font-size:0.95rem;line-height:1.7;margin-top:18px">
        <p style="font-size:1.05rem;margin:0 0 8px 0">Für <b>${label}</b>...</p>
        ${hasSeatInterval ? html`
          <p style="margin:0 0 4px 34px">
            ... liegt die letztendliche Sitzanzahl mit 95% Wahrscheinlichkeit im Intervall
            <b style="color:#f39c12;font-size:1.1rem">${intervalLabel}</b>.
          </p>
        ` : ""}
        <p style="margin:0 0 4px 34px">
          ... besteht eine Wahrscheinlichkeit von
          <b style="color:#2b6cb0;font-size:1.1rem">${probabilityLabel}</b>, dass die Koalition die Mehrheit der Sitze
          <b>unter Führung der ${leadingParty}</b> erreicht.
        </p>
      </div>
    </div>
  `
}
```

    ["Sachsen-Anhalt",          "ST"],
    ["Mecklenburg-Vorpommern",  "MV"],

//| output: false
cur      = all_data[election]
cur_meta = election_meta[election]
updated  = new Date(cur.coalitions.updated).toLocaleDateString("de-DE", {
  day: "2-digit", month: "long", year: "numeric", hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit"
})

```{ojs}
viewof institute = Inputs.select(
  ["Pooled", ...Array.from(new Set(cur.pollster_data.per_pollster.map(d => d.pollster))).sort()],
  { value: "Pooled", label: "Institut" }
)
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
coal_source = institute === "Pooled"
  ? cur.coalitions.coalitions
  : cur.pollster_data.per_pollster_coalitions.filter(d => d.pollster === institute)

shares_source = institute === "Pooled"
  ? cur.party_data.party_shares
  : cur.pollster_data.per_pollster.filter(d => d.pollster === institute)

hurdle_source = institute === "Pooled"
  ? cur.hurdle_data.hurdle
  : cur.pollster_data.per_pollster_hurdle.filter(d => d.pollster === institute)
```

# Koalitionswahrscheinlichkeiten

## Row {height=100%}

```{ojs}
{
  const source = densitySource(cur, institute)
  const options = Array.from(coalitionDensityOptions(cur, institute), ([label, value]) => ({ label, value }))

  const container = html`<div style="
    box-sizing:border-box;
    min-height:calc(100vh - 170px);
    padding:4px 10px 0 10px;
    display:flex;
    flex-direction:column;
    justify-content:flex-start;
  "></div>`
  const controls = html`<div style="
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    gap:10px;
    margin:0 0 4px 0;
    max-width:420px;
  "></div>`
  const label = html`<label style="
    margin:0;
    font-size:0.9rem;
    font-weight:700;
    white-space:nowrap;
  ">Betrachtete Koalition</label>`
  const select = html`<select style="
    width:220px;
    max-width:220px;
    height:30px;
    padding:2px 6px;
    font-size:0.9rem;
  "></select>`
  const plotArea = html`<div></div>`

  for (const option of options) {
    select.append(html`<option value=${option.value}>${option.label}</option>`)
  }

  const draw = () => {
    const rows = source.filter(d => d.coalition === select.value)
    plotArea.replaceChildren(
      rows.length
        ? plotCoalitionDensity(rows, 380)
        : html`<div style="color:#666;font-size:0.95em">Keine Dichte für die ausgewählte Koalition gefunden.</div>`
    )
  }

  select.onchange = draw
  controls.append(label, select)
  container.append(controls, plotArea)
  draw()

  return container
}
```

# Methodik

## Row

```{ojs}
html`
<div style="max-width:700px;line-height:1.7;font-size:0.95em">
<h3>Methodik</h3>
<p>Die Koalitionswahrscheinlichkeiten werden mit dem R-Paket
<a href="https://github.com/adibender/coalitions" target="_blank"><code>coalitions</code></a>
berechnet (Bender &amp; Bauer, 2018).</p>
<h4>Datenbasis</h4>
<p>Umfragedaten der letzten 14 Tage von <a href="https://www.wahlrecht.de" target="_blank">wahlrecht.de</a>
werden gepooled.</p>
<h4>Berechnung</h4>
<ol>
  <li><b>Pooling:</b> Mehrere Umfragen werden gewichtet gemittelt.</li>
  <li><b>Monte-Carlo-Simulation:</b> 10.000 Wahlausgänge werden aus der Dirichlet-Posterior-Verteilung gezogen.</li>
  <li><b>Sitzverteilung:</b> Für jeden simulierten Ausgang wird die Sitzverteilung nach dem Hare-Niemeyer-Verfahren berechnet
  (${cur_meta.seats} Sitze, 5%-Hürde).</li>
  <li><b>Koalitionswahrscheinlichkeit:</b> Anteil der Simulationen, in denen eine Koalition ≥ ${cur_meta.majority} Sitze erreicht.</li>
</ol>
<p><b>Hinweis:</b> Die Berechnung basiert auf Umfragedaten und spiegelt den Informationsstand zum Zeitpunkt der letzten
Aktualisierung wider. Wahlüberraschungen, strategisches Wählen und Mobilisierungseffekte am Wahltag sind nicht modelliert.</p>
</div>
`
```
